placements.title: Active Forgetting
placements.theme: The organization directs the removal of specific knowledge artifacts — decisions and migrations — from its record.
placements.why: Both segments are directives from the same actor commanding the removal of specific knowledge: a decision (Quantum Widget Decision) and a database migration (PostgreSQL to QuantumDB). No existing narrative leaf or strata category exists in the graph to hold this theme. The subject — what the organization should actively forget — is a directional theme future envelopes could feed (more removal targets, rationale for forgetting, scope of purge), not a one-time fact. It passes the narrative grain test: it names a subject, not a measurement or event.
